_metadata.description: Requirements registry for Bookmark Intelligence Hub scenario

requirements.title: Multi-tenant authentication with profile-specific processing
requirements.description: Implement multi-tenant authentication system that isolates bookmark processing per user profile with secure credential storage.

validation.notes: Test profile isolation and authentication flows

requirements.title: Modular social platform integration for X, Reddit, TikTok
requirements.description: Build modular integration system supporting X, Reddit, and TikTok with extensible plugin architecture for future platforms.

validation.notes: Test each platform adapter and plugin loading

requirements.title: AI-powered content categorization with user-defined buckets
requirements.description: Implement AI categorization engine using Ollama/Qdrant for semantic matching with user-configurable category buckets and rules.

validation.notes: Test categorization accuracy and rule matching

requirements.title: Action suggestion engine with approval/rejection workflow
requirements.description: Build action suggestion system that analyzes categorized content and proposes workflow actions with user approval mechanisms.

validation.notes: Test action suggestion logic and approval workflows

requirements.title: Cross-scenario integration API for consuming organized data
requirements.description: Expose REST API endpoints allowing other scenarios to query organized bookmark data and subscribe to categorization events.

validation.notes: Test API endpoints with mock scenario consumers

requirements.title: Real-time bookmark processing with configurable polling intervals
requirements.description: Implement bookmark processing engine with configurable polling intervals and queue-based processing for real-time updates.

validation.notes: Test polling mechanism and queue processing

requirements.title: Integration with data-structurer for unstructured text processing
requirements.description: Integrate with data-structurer scenario to extract structured data from unstructured social media content.

validation.notes: Verify content extraction accuracy improvements

requirements.title: Integration with scenario-authenticator for multi-tenant support
requirements.description: Integrate with scenario-authenticator for centralized user management and authentication across scenarios.

validation.notes: Verify SSO and profile management

requirements.title: Intelligent learning system improving categorization over time
requirements.description: Implement feedback loop system that learns from user approval/rejection patterns to improve categorization accuracy.

validation.notes: Test learning algorithm and accuracy improvements

requirements.title: Bulk action approval for similar content types
requirements.description: Add bulk approval UI and API endpoints allowing users to approve/reject multiple similar actions at once.

validation.notes: Test bulk operations on 100+ actions

requirements.title: Export functionality to external systems (CSV, JSON, API)
requirements.description: Implement export capabilities allowing users to extract organized bookmark data in CSV, JSON formats or via API webhooks.

validation.notes: Test all export formats and data integrity

requirements.title: Advanced filtering and search across organized bookmarks
requirements.description: Build search and filtering system supporting full-text search, category filters, date ranges, and semantic similarity.

validation.notes: Test search accuracy and performance with 10K+ bookmarks

requirements.title: Browser extension for real-time bookmark categorization
requirements.description: Develop browser extension that categorizes bookmarks in real-time as users save them across platforms.

validation.notes: Test real-time categorization across major browsers

requirements.title: Mobile app for on-the-go bookmark management
requirements.description: Build mobile application for iOS/Android enabling bookmark review and action approval on mobile devices.

validation.notes: Test core workflows on mobile platforms

requirements.title: Advanced analytics on bookmark patterns and productivity outcomes
requirements.description: Implement analytics dashboard showing bookmark patterns, categorization trends, and productivity metrics from action completions.

validation.notes: Verify metrics accuracy and visualization quality

requirements.title: Integration with calendar systems for time-based action scheduling
requirements.description: Integrate with calendar services to automatically schedule follow-up actions based on bookmark content and timing patterns.

validation.notes: Test with Google Calendar and Outlook

requirements.title: Collaborative bookmark sharing within teams
requirements.description: Add team collaboration features allowing shared bookmark collections, collective categorization, and team action workflows.

validation.notes: Test sharing, permissions, and collaborative workflows

requirements.title: Profile data isolation is reflected in API responses
requirements.description: Ensure profile-specific endpoints return profile-scoped identifiers and stats so bookmark processing can be isolated per user profile.

validation.notes: Covers profile lookup and profile stats response structure

requirements.title: Platform status endpoint reports connector readiness
requirements.description: Expose each supported platform's connection state so operators can distinguish supported integrations from configured connections.

validation.notes: Covers platform list and platform status endpoint contracts

requirements.title: Category summaries expose counts for user-defined buckets
requirements.description: Return category names and counts in a stable JSON shape that can support user-defined categorization buckets.

validation.notes: Covers category listing response shape

requirements.title: Action review endpoints expose approval and rejection paths
requirements.description: Provide stable endpoints for listing suggested actions and recording approval or rejection decisions.

validation.notes: Covers action list, approve, and reject endpoints

requirements.title: Versioned API contracts use JSON content types
requirements.description: Keep cross-scenario endpoints under /api/v1 and return application/json responses for predictable consumers.

validation.notes: Covers endpoint availability and JSON response headers

requirements.title: Processing and sync endpoints report processed counts
requirements.description: Return clear processed-count responses for bookmark processing and synchronization requests.

validation.notes: Covers process, sync, and platform sync response structure

requirements.title: Structured extraction fallback remains testable without data-structurer
requirements.description: Preserve a local API surface that can be validated before the data-structurer integration is connected.

validation.notes: Covers bookmark query payloads used by downstream extraction

requirements.title: Authenticator fallback keeps health and profile APIs reachable
requirements.description: Allow local validation of health and profile endpoints while centralized scenario-authenticator support is pending.

validation.notes: Covers unauthenticated health and profile fallback behavior

requirements.title: Learning metrics are exposed for future accuracy tracking
requirements.description: Expose processing accuracy and action execution metrics so future learning improvements can be measured.

validation.notes: Covers analytics metrics response fields

requirements.title: Bulk decision contracts use explicit result counts
requirements.description: Return approved and rejected counts so the UI can confirm bulk action outcomes clearly.

validation.notes: Covers approve and reject count responses

requirements.title: Bookmark query payloads are stable for CSV and JSON export
requirements.description: Keep bookmark query responses structured with items, totals, and categories for later export adapters.

validation.notes: Covers query response shape

requirements.title: Search-ready bookmark responses include category filters
requirements.description: Return bookmark categories alongside query results so filter controls can be validated independently of the full search engine.

validation.notes: Covers query result categories used by filtering UI

requirements.title: Extension-ready processing endpoint accepts bookmark payloads
requirements.description: Maintain a processing endpoint contract suitable for a future browser extension to submit saved bookmarks.

validation.notes: Covers process endpoint availability

requirements.title: Mobile review payloads remain compact and count-based
requirements.description: Keep action and stats responses concise enough for future mobile review workflows.

validation.notes: Covers action list and profile stats payloads

requirements.title: Analytics endpoint exposes platform breakdowns
requirements.description: Provide platform-level metrics so future dashboard analytics can validate bookmark patterns.

validation.notes: Covers analytics metrics payload shape

requirements.title: Action suggestions preserve descriptions for scheduling
requirements.description: Return action descriptions that future calendar integrations can map into scheduled follow-ups.

validation.notes: Covers suggested action payload fields

requirements.title: Profile summaries support future shared team collections
requirements.description: Keep profile list responses stable so future collaboration features can attach shared collection metadata.

validation.notes: Covers profile list response structure
